comment: Which milestone of BUILD.md owes each clause of the specifications and each kind of test-vector case. `completed` lists the milestones that are done. `pnpm spec:coverage` fails if a MUST-level clause owed by a completed milestone has no passing test that cites it, or if a vector case owed by one is still pending. A clause is matched by its own ID, then by its section, then by its document.
